paragraphs.text: Attendee is a token -only acorn class used to represent convention go-ers at MagicCons .

Attendee debuted as a creature type 2023 as part of the Heroes of the Realm celebration card Svega, the Unconventional . Svega is a reference to Las Vegas which has been a location for several MagicCons. She is a planeswalker with a loyalty ability that creates Attendee tokens for each planeswalker type the player controls for -2 loyalty.
